label: FUS::ERG

sections.text: FUS encodes an RNA-binding protein involved in RNA processing and transcriptional regulation.
ERG encodes an ETS-family transcription factor involved in vascular and hematopoietic development.

The t(16;21)(p11;q22) fusion combines the FUS transcriptional activation region with ERG DNA-binding sequences, creating an aberrant ETS transcription factor. It defines a rare AML subtype distinct from RUNX1::CBFA2T3 AML.
FUS::ERG also occurs rarely in Ewing sarcoma. The adverse AML outcome association below applies to pediatric leukemia, not to all tumors with this pair.
Pediatric FUS::ERG AML has shown poor outcomes and frequent relapse in the international I-BFM cohort.
